sample.note: Three read-only reviewer contexts, none of which wrote the branch, given the same pinned diff and claim with isolated axes: security and trust boundaries; correctness, concurrency and durability; and whether the new tests actually catch the bugs they claim to. One wide sample, not one per axis per retry.

resolved_blockers: root pin inspected only the `root` field: `index_cache`, `dir` and `scip` walked past it, and a request naming no root at all skipped the pin entirely -- reviewer returned verbatim source from outside the pin
`serve` had no pin at all, and the README I had written claimed all three long-running surfaces confined requests
request-supplied `dir` wrote durable state outside the pin through memory_* and session_continuation
`PageRankScores` read `s.data` above its own lock -- a data race introduced by the commit that was removing data races, race-detector confirmed
`RunCortexMaintenanceOpts` is a read-modify-write across individually-locked calls; two concurrent waves left 3 of 40 summaries. Locking the parts and leaving the composition torn.
confirmed_correct: no remaining re-entrant lock path (independent go/ast analyzer, 48 locking methods, 0 chains)
PPR dangling-mass rewrite is mathematically correct across 11 graph shapes
`recover()` restores the named return on every path and strands no lock
`boundedIntField` float handling is correct for NaN, Inf and near-MaxInt64

test_oracles.note: The most consequential axis. Two recorded red proofs did not happen: R-003's test never called flush and reimplemented the fixed logic inline, and C-002's test never induced a panic. Both passed with their fix entirely removed. Both rewritten and genuinely red-proved. The reviewer also showed the wiring layer was untested by reintroducing the RCE one level above the gate with every package staying green; that is now covered and red-proved.
test_oracles.relabelled: Sixteen rows whose fix could be reverted with the suite green are relabelled FIXED-UNPROVEN, with the missing test named in HARDENING.md.

honest_note: Every blocker on this branch that was introduced rather than inherited -- the pin gaps, the unpinned serve surface, the PageRankScores race, the torn maintenance composition, and both fabricated red proofs -- was found by a reviewer, not by the implementer or the suite. That is the argument for the sample, and it is why self-approval is not review.
